gen-gf-martian-mono-archivo: Archivo reads editorial, curves opening outward, a commanding x-height under Martian Mono. And the mono grid stretches wide over that sans-serif, both holding joints without pinching.
gen-gf-martian-mono-manrope: Stretched mono beats in Martian Mono, then a bright-mouthed sans. Manrope still holds if the copy drops a size, a one-width pen under that grid throughout.
gen-gf-matangi-fs-erode: Brush-lifted curve ends mark Matangi, a wire-constant sans over Erode. Erode adds a medium weight change, so heading and serif share the sheet without flattening out.
gen-gf-michroma-fs-karma: Karma sits classic, a modest modulation under wide Michroma. A slightly reduced size still holds, beside that funnel-throated e and a heading that runs extra wide.
gen-gf-mitr-fs-karma: Barely-there ascenders in Mitr, then a classic serif below. Karma keeps copy moving under Mitr with a mild stress in the rounds and terminals that stop short of each stem.
gen-gf-mochiy-pop-one-fs-karma: Karma sits classic under Mochiy Pop One's bold, one-weight letters and wide gaps. Karma keeps copy moving with a subdued contrast that never snags through dense copy.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-fs-asap: Refined slabs against open-arc sans-serif: Montagu Slab over readable Asap. Asap stands almost cap-high under Montagu Slab, so the two share a stocky, low-drama sheet throughout.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is an approachable, unclamped sans-serif under Montagu Slab's restrained thick-thin. And it keeps copy moving on a one-nib line, stubby extenders under those restrained slab serifs.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-fs-supreme: Supreme is a crisp sans under Montagu Slab, a heavy middle strip with letters held open, not curled shut. The hook is restrained slab stress against that flat strip.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-manrope: Manrope reads clean, bright mouths and a one-width pen under Montagu Slab. And the slab's restrained thick-thin rides that plain sans without adding extra hairlines below.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern under Montagu Slab, c tips held apart and joins matching every stroke. And a half-step drop in the copy still reads under the quiet slab.
gen-gf-mozilla-headline-fs-erode: Mozilla Headline lifts lowercase close to the caps, with open jaws on every curve, over Erode. Nudge the copy down a size and it still holds.
gen-gf-mozilla-text-fs-erode: Erode sits editorial under Mozilla Text, a gentle ebb of weight and a broad g against low-stress sans. The copy can drop a point and still stay clear.
gen-gf-mukta-fs-karma: Karma sits classic under Mukta's towering lowercase, a modern sans punch. And it keeps copy moving with a restrained swell in the curves that never snags.
gen-gf-narnoor-fs-karma: Karma sits classic under Narnoor's large-eyed, clean, contemporary lowercase. Karma then keeps copy moving with medium stroke contrast, terminals stopping short of each stem, never snagging.
